name: Hybrid
notes: Known from 2 posts to rec.sport.pro-wrestling.fantasy (16 May 1999 and 6 August 2000), served at /promotions/rspwf/archive/sample-roleplay-hybrid-1999-05-16.html and /promotions/rspwf/archive/flash-critique-hybrid-2000-08-06.html: Hybrid, the NAIWF Rising Star Champion, travels by limousine from O'Hare to his hotel and promises to beat the Mad Russian, then The Outsider and Russel Snow in a Television Title triple threat.
caption: A technical-submission NAIWF wrestler and former Rising Star and Intercontinental champion known from two roleplays of May 1999 and May 2000.
